title: Efficient Magic State Cultivation for $\sqrt{T}$ Gates
summary: Recently, experimental and theoretical quantum error correction methodology has seen remarkable breakthroughs. In particular, magic state cultivation has been shown to simplify magic-state preparation and make it feasible for near-term devices. However, recent research on magic state cultivation has focused primarily on the cultivation of $T\left| + \right>_L$. Only a few other magic state cultivation methods beyond $T\left| + \right>_L$ have been investigated.
